title: Phase 2.2 — Bot Health Check: Verify MGM + DD status bots
spec:
PHASE 2.2: BOTS-HEALTH-CHECK

Verify health of the two daily status bots that run in production via GitHub Actions.

LOCATIONS (master folder paths):
  - bots/mgm-status-bot/
  - bots/dd-status-bot/

TASK 1: For EACH bot, check:
  a. Review .github/workflows/ for the daily report workflow YAML
  b. Verify Python version in workflow is current (3.11+ preferred, not deprecated)
  c. List all required secrets/env vars and whether they're documented
  d. Check if a --dry-run or test mode exists
  e. Review send_reports.py for any obvious errors or deprecated API usage
  f. Check subscribers.json — is it current and well-formed?

TASK 2: mgm-status-bot specific:
  - Check if WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN usage is correct (env var, not hardcoded)
  - Look for any error handling around 401/auth failures
  - Verify subscribers.json has valid Webex room/person IDs
  - Check if the recurring 401 error from May 8 has a fix or workaround

TASK 3: dd-status-bot specific:
  - Check how SpaceLift space discovery works (webex_spacelift.py)
  - Verify WEBEX_ACCESS_TOKEN usage pattern
  - Check if webex_recordings.py and send_email_report.py are functional
  - Verify error handling for token expiry

TASK 4: Security check
  - grep -r "AKIA\|sk_live\|ghp_\|Y2lz\|Bearer " in both bot directories
  - Verify no hardcoded tokens in source files
  - Confirm .env files are gitignored if present
  - Check GitHub Actions workflow for proper secrets usage (secrets.XXX not plaintext)

TASK 5: Report
  For each bot, provide:
  - Status: HEALTHY / NEEDS-ATTENTION / BROKEN
  - Last known working state (from workflow YAML or README)
  - List of issues found
  - Recommended fixes (if any)

CONSTRAINTS:
  - Read-only audit — do NOT modify working bot code
  - Fix only documentation gaps (README, missing comments)
  - Report all findings to Windsurf before any changes
